name: jlink-nrf52840-dk
experiment:
# SEGGER J-Link (nRF52840 DK on-board J-Link OB) with RTT and read-only steps.
# Needs SEGGER's JLinkExe (see docs/hardware.md). Nothing here writes, erases
# or programs the target.
#
#   HWLAB_JLINK_EXE=~/sdk/jlink/JLink_Linux_V982_x86_64/JLinkExe hwlab run examples/jlink-nrf52840-dk.yaml
name: jlink-nrf52840-dk
duration: 6s

devices:
  dbg:
    plugin: jlink
    target: NRF52840_XXAA

steps:
  - {name: probe-info, at: 4s, device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.info}
  - {name: read-vectors, at: 4500ms, device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.read, args: {address: "0x0", length: 16}}

clock.source: host clock at RTT telnet receive (target writes are polled by the probe)
clock.note: the stamp is late by the unknown probe polling + USB + TCP latency and never early; lines are not stamped by the target; 3 lines, 112 bytes
